welcome.body: We’d like to get to know you a little better so HappyDate can help you find thoughtful gifts, remember what matters and create special moments
welcome.rewardBody: Complete this short questionnaire to receive your first 100 HappyDate points

birthday.title: When is your special day? 🎂
birthday.body: We’d love to remember your birthday too
birthday.label: Date of birth

likes.title: What brings you joy? 🎁
likes.body: Choose everything you like. If something is missing, add your own option
likes.customPlaceholder: For example, vinyl records, houseplants, cycling…

dislikes.title: Which gifts are definitely not for you? 🙈
dislikes.body: Everyone has different tastes. Tell us what you would rather avoid so recommendations can fit better
dislikes.customPlaceholder: For example, I like flowers but not roses…
dislikes.conflict: This category is both liked and disliked. That’s okay — you can clarify with your own note.

dreams.body: It could be a special trip, a new hobby or a small thing you have wanted for a while. No dream is too big or too small
